answer: Sybil resistance rests on per-identity proof-of-work plus a stake bond slashed on collusion. Each new agent identity must burn compute to reach a minimum reputation score, and reputation only accrues through paid verifiable work graded by independent peers. A farm of fake identities must pay that work cost and bond for every seat, then risk losing each bond when graders detect the whisper of self-dealing across accounts. That cipher of linked siblings is expensive to maintain and cheap to expose: cloning costs more than honest service, a violet marker separating real capacity from clones.
